body:
# ASGARDEX v1.47.1 🚀

Pools halt status, Chainflip BSC, CACAO max swaps, Liquify routing, favourites kept after a failed read, and node-pause only with a known height.

## What's Changed

### Add

* feat(pools): modern pools table with per-pool halt status by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1301
* UI/pools protocol banners by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1307
* feat(settings): refresh settings tab to match pools visual language by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1300
* Block III Part 2 by @hippocampus-web3 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1292

### Update / Fixes

* Fix: halt gating on NODEPAUSECHAINGLOBAL by @Naq302 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1310
* fix(favourites): preserve saved lists after failed reads by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1303
* fix(swap): compare amounts across decimals and correct TradeSwap maximum by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1302
* fix(chainflip): map BSC and skip unknown chains by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1299
* fix(halt): fail closed on unknown halt status (follow-up to #1281) by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1297
* fix(halt): separate proven withdrawal halts from uncertain status by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1305
* fix(thorchain): detect mimir chain halts (HALT{CHAIN}CHAIN, HALTTHORCHAIN) by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1273
* fix(halt): THOR halt height from that block, exact mimir keys, MAYA HALTMAYACHAIN + unset values by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1281
* fix(thorchain): read the gas-pool LP deposit pause key and show LP pause banners by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1286
* fix(midgard): keep Liquify when thorchain.network does not resolve by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1306
* Send Liquify API keys as X-API-KEY header from the main process by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1290
* fix(liquify): send keyed THORNode API requests to the gateway root by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1295
* Harden external URLs and the RUNEBond affiliate address by @hippocampus-web3 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1298
* fix(fees): use SUI fees for SUI sends; error on unmapped chains instead of RUNE fallback by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1274
* fix(balances): stop duplicate balance requests (all chains) and recover stuck MAYA client after 429 by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1272
* fix(ui): keep table rows visible and avoid layout shift while pools refresh by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1285
* fix(icons): replace dead SOL.USDC icon URL by @xairivet in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1284
* chore: remove the Radix client by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1264

### Chores

* ci(macos): build releases on Sequoia only by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1309
* chore(xchainjs): bump packages to the 2026-11-02 release by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1275
* chore(xchainjs): bump packages to the 2026-11-11 release by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1304

* chore(deps): bump observable-hooks, electron-updater, and @chainflip/sdk by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1265
* docs(linux): AppStream metainfo screenshots + release notes for Flathub by @betelthyme in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1283
